sources.title: everyscribe/diar_streaming_sortformer_4spk-v2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A new version of streaming Sortformer v2.1 has been released, providing greater robustness for meeting speech. Streaming Sortformer Diarizer 4spk v2 | This model is a streaming version of Sortformer diarizer. Sortformer [1] is a novel end-to-end neural model for speaker diarization, trained with unconventional objectives compared to existing end-to-end diarization models.

sources.title: diar_streaming_sortformer_4spk-v2: Audio-to-Text model — overview, use ...
sources.snippet: diar_sortformer_4spk-v1 is the offline (non-streaming) version with 123M parameters (6M more than v2). Use v1 if you can tolerate end-to-end latency and need higher accuracy, since offline models access full recording context.

sources.title: GitHub - hieuxinloi/Sortformer-Speaker-Diarization
sources.snippet: This project implements fine-tuning for the Sortformer model from NVIDIA (a Transformer-based encoder-labeler architecture) for the Speaker Diarization task ("who spoke when"). The model is optimized for streaming audio and is capable of separating the voices of up to 4 simultaneous speakers, maintaining high accuracy even in scenarios with overlapping speech.

sources.title: diar_streaming_sortformer_4spk-v2.1: Audio-to-Text model — overview ...
sources.snippet: diar_sortformer_4spk-v1 is the offline (non-streaming) version with 123M parameters and 18-layer NEST encoder. Choose v2.1 for production streaming systems where you cannot wait for complete audio; use v1 if you process batch files offline and want marginally higher parameter count (6M more).
